triggers.trigger_condition: Measured or credibly forecast cost per completed valid session changes materially at the planned volume, or an alternative becomes cheaper while meeting all hard constraints.
triggers.required_evidence: Volume forecast, itemized storage/egress/compute/ASR/operations costs, quotes, switching and migration cost.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Require a registered break-even and materiality threshold before release; compare total cost at observed and forecast volumes, including exit cost.
triggers.interim_disposition: Continue under cost watch unless the approved budget guardrail is breached; then suspend expansion pending owner review.

triggers.trigger_condition: A new product feature, response mode, research protocol or accessibility requirement is incompatible with the pinned adapter or media/data contract.
triggers.required_evidence: Changed requirement/version, failing contract test, affected users and mode, alternative design and compatibility evidence.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Re-run affected verification checks; update the option review and test whether the incumbent or replacement meets the new hard requirements.
triggers.interim_disposition: Do not expose the new feature on the incompatible path; offer the approved existing or alternate mode.

triggers.trigger_condition: A vendor/API/browser/package change, end-of-support notice or dependency update breaks a promised interface or recovery behavior.
triggers.required_evidence: Version diff, changelog, failing conformance test, affected binding and rollback or pinning feasibility.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Treat breaking behavior as a failed contract; compare pin, patch, adapter and replacement options.
triggers.interim_disposition: Pin or roll back where safe; hold affected deployment if no conforming version remains.

triggers.trigger_condition: ASR, capture or scoring evidence quality fails a predeclared threshold or differs materially by language, device, access mode or subgroup.
triggers.required_evidence: Versioned errors, blind reference or independent task comparison, uncertainty and subgroup/mode denominators.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Re-run E03/E05 or the affected technical contract with locked evaluation criteria.
triggers.interim_disposition: Hold automated scoring or narrow the supported mode until evidence supports use.

triggers.trigger_condition: Processor terms, data location, retention/deletion, license or security posture changes beyond the approved boundary.
triggers.required_evidence: Changed terms/advisory, data-flow map, exposed records, deletion status, alternative terms and legal/privacy review.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Privacy/security owner assesses continued permission; rerun deletion, access and data-route checks.
triggers.interim_disposition: Stop affected data transfer or access when required by the approved policy; preserve incident evidence.

triggers.trigger_condition: Failure, latency, orphan-object, recovery or support burden breaches a registered service guardrail.
triggers.required_evidence: Incident series, denominators, device/network strata, operational load and replayable failure traces.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Compare mitigation versus replacement using the same synthetic fault suite and pilot guardrails.
triggers.interim_disposition: Hold affected mode or new invitations where user harm or unverified media custody is material.

triggers.trigger_condition: Maintainer abandonment, service discontinuation, lock-in or inability to export/delete makes future operation or exit doubtful.
triggers.required_evidence: Support notice, release cadence, export/delete drill, migration estimate and available substitutes.
triggers.reassessment_gate: Price and test exit, data migration and parallel operation before approving a successor.
triggers.interim_disposition: Retain a bounded current version only if safety and rights obligations remain satisfied.
